title: Dropping Ball
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: A board of M rows and N columns holds one diagonal wall per cell, slanting either way. A ball dropped at the top of a column slides along the walls and either leaves sideways, jams between two walls, or reaches the bottom. Queries flip one wall or drop a ball, reporting its bottom exit column or minus one. Cell count and query count are each at most 100000.
